The **Multi-Purpose Axe** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The weapon has a decent damage output but a slow swing speed. It consists of a simple axe head with a long wooden handle. It cannot be modified, and will not appear in the menu when at a Weapons Workbench.
